name: Simon Fraser University
feeMethod: Charges international undergraduates per unit, with a basic rate for most courses and premium rates for Engineering Science and upper-level Computing Science and Business; the calculator uses the matching rate times 30 units a year. Research master's pay one regular fee; professional master's have their own rates.
description: Simon Fraser University is a public research university founded in 1965, with campuses in Burnaby, Surrey and Vancouver, British Columbia. It includes the Beedie School of Business and the Faculty of Applied Sciences.
whyIncluded: Simon Fraser University is an NUS Student Exchange Programme partner, so NUS undergraduates can spend a semester studying at SFU.

livingCosts.summary: The university's own estimate for an international first-year student in a residence room with meal plan over two terms (8 months); transit pass is in student fees.
livingCosts.notes: SFU admission 'fees and scholarships' page, 2026/27 international estimate for one academic year (two terms, 30 units): single residence room (North Towers) with meal plan C$15,014 (combined housing and food, so all in housing), textbooks, technology and supplies C$2,400 (personal). Transport 0: U-Pass is in tuition and fees (C$38,944). Medical insurance C$945 excluded.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Applied Science (BASc) in Engineering Science
programmes.feeBasis: SFU's 2026-27 premium international rate for Engineering Science (C$1,348.19 a unit) times 30 units, a full-time year, plus student fees.
programmes.summary: Annual tuition for new international students taking 30 units (10 courses) a year, plus compulsory student fees incl. transit pass. Fees can rise each year. Health insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: SFU 2026 Fall Calendar, undergraduate international tuition, 'Engineering Science, Mechatronic Systems, Sustainable Energy Engineering (premium - per unit)', for students who entered in 2024/2025 or later: C$1,348.19/unit x 30 units (full-time year). Compulsory = full-time student fees per term from the same Calendar page: student services 54.11 + recreation-athletics 90.14 + student activity 191.91 + U-Pass BC 191.40 = C$527.56 x 2 terms = C$1,055.12; opt-out extended health and dental and the international medical insurance (C$281/term) excluded. Cross-check: SFU's admission page estimates C$38,944 tuition and fees for an international student taking 30 units in 2026/27 (basic rate x 30 + these fees = C$38,941.52). Rates are per entry cohort but the Calendar notes they can change. History (read 2026-10-13): 2024 row from the Fall 2024 Calendar tuition-fees page, international Engineering Science premium rate for students entering 2024/2025 or later C$1,246.48/unit x 30; compulsory = student services and recreation-athletics (four or more units) 138.65 + student activity 172.65 + U-Pass BC 184.00 = C$495.30 x 2 terms. 2025 row from the Summer 2026 Calendar tuition-fees page (the 2025/26 schedule; it links separately to 2026/27 fees, and the Fall 2025 Calendar pages are blocked to automated reading): Engineering Science premium rate C$1,296.34/unit x 30; compulsory = student services 53.05 + recreation-athletics 88.37 + student activity 177.91 + U-Pass BC 187.60 = C$506.93 x 2 terms.

programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for the 30-unit MEng, which takes six terms (2 years), charged per unit; plus compulsory student fees incl. transit pass. Health insurance extra.
programmes.notes: SFU 2026 Fall Calendar graduate fees, 'Master of Engineering if entered in 2024/2025 or later', international C$939.86/unit. Programme: minimum 30 units, expected in six terms (Calendar programme page), so annual = 15 units x rate = C$14,097.90. Compulsory = graduate student fees per term from the same Calendar page: student activity 80.84 + U-Pass BC 191.40 + recreation-athletics (full-time) 90.14 + student services 54.11 = C$416.49 x 3 terms = C$1,249.47; health/dental and international medical insurance excluded. History (read 2026-10-13): 2024 row from the Fall 2024 Calendar graduate fees page, MEng (entered 2024/2025 or later) C$868.95/unit x 15; graduate student fees C$400.33 per term x 3. 2025 row from the Summer 2026 Calendar graduate fees page (the 2025/26 schedule; Fall 2025 Calendar pages are blocked to automated reading), C$903.71/unit x 15; graduate student fees 79.52 + 187.60 + 88.37 + 53.05 = C$408.54 per term x 3.
